newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says Kurdish rebels kill three civilians.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says Kurdish rebels kill three civilians.

text.p: Turkey said on Friday that Kurdish guerrillas had killed three civilians, two of them children, in the southeast of the country.

The regional governor's office in the city of Diyarbakir said Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels shot the victims dead as they were grazing livestock in the village of Kayhan on Thursday morning. Two civilians were wounded, it said.
No independent confirmation of the attack was available.
State-run Anatolian news agency named the dead as Kalo Korkut 59, Faruk Korkut, 12, and eight-year-old Fulya Bozkurt.
More than 21,000 people have died in 12 years of conflict between security forces and rebels fighting for Kurdish autonomy or independence in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
